decision_text: Metadata proxy is not reliable enough to serve as the source of a four-level semantic SID under the current protocol.

primary_candidate_codebook.resource_note: A 200000-item provisional fit was attempted but exceeded the 2-GiB runtime memory boundary; the Gate-1 candidate was reduced to 100000 without changing the 100000-item proxy validation sample or Gate-2 full-fit requirement.

selected_conditional_rule_for_evaluation.authorization_boundary: This is the best evaluated proxy rule, not an approved semantic-SID materialization rule.

codebook_sensitivity.conclusion: The coarse-to-fine collapse is stable across two independently fitted real-only codebooks.

reasoning: Cosine similarity is moderately high, but the task-priority four-level PrefixAcc is only 2.01% under the best conditional rule.
Exact nearest-neighbor overlap is only 24.83% at 10 and 37.87% at 50.
The best both-available validation alpha collapses to album-only rather than a genuine artist-album blend.
Album-only targets are especially weak: PrefixAcc@1 39.05% and PrefixAcc@4 0.65%.
No availability, group-size, or frequency stratum demonstrates reliable four-level path recovery.

gate2_block.reason: Gate 2 requires a Gate-1-confirmed proxy rule to quantize 450594 metadata-available items. Gate 1 rejected metadata proxies as a four-level semantic-SID source.
unauthorized_alternatives: Force the failed proxy rule into the frozen quantizer
Silently relabel all 450594 metadata-available items as cold_unknown
Remove those items from the explicit item universe
gate2_block.additional_resource_issue: No GPU is visible and the runtime memory limit is 2 GiB; the existing non-streaming full 2367341-item RQ implementation cannot fit.
